locator: I q.9 a.1 co.: ex praemissis ostenditur Deum esse omnino immutabilem
interpretation: Aquinas shows God altogether immutable: (1) the first being is pure act without admixture of potency, and whatever is changed in any way is in some way in potency; (2) composition; (3) the infinite acquires nothing. The claim records the conclusion as Aquinas states it. CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-IMMUTABLE derives it by the first reason: whatever is God is maximal in being, hence the first being (open bridge), and the first being is in potency in no respect (q.3 a.1).
